remarks: Experience total comfort and classic craftsmanship in this immaculately maintained detached condo located in Woodbury, a resort-inspired Irvine community. Step through the arched doorway to find a light-filled private courtyard oasis featuring a soothing water fountain, ideal for al fresco dining and enjoying the SoCal weather year-round. The floor plan is both functional and inviting, with fresh paint and brand-new, never-lived-on carpets. Unwind in the living room with a cozy fireplace, built-in media center, and Triad integrated sound system. Gather in the spacious kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, marble flooring, prep island, and handsome wood cabinetry
